payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all possible common numbers (1-9) and check if exactly one is consistent with given pair sets; else test if participants can deduce but we can't.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tests each number i from 1 to 9, verifying if there exists a pair in each participant's list containing i, ensuring distinct pairs, and checks conditions. This is a simple complete search. No sorting-based algorithm or bit manipulation.
